openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolveResponse'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySunid
      summary: Node by public SUNID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/LineageOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/children:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidChildren
      summary: Seek-paginated child nodes
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ChildrenOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/annotations:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidAnnotations
      summary: Comments, inconsistencies, repeats, and xrefs
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/AnnotationsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/images:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidImages
      summary: Thumbnail and larger static images for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ImagesOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/homology:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidHomology
      summary: Homology scope and warnings for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/HomologyOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/fatcat-chain-statistics:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidFatcatChainStatistics
      summary: Node-specific FATCAT chain-statistics classification consistency
      description: >
        Returns the classification match fraction and observation count for a
        family, superfamily, or fold SUNID. These are stored historical
        classification-consistency aggregates, not evidence of homology or the
        probability that a current hit is correct. Provenance fields are omitted
        pending a better provenance implementation. No provenance metadata table
        is required. The release parameter selects the classification context.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/statisticsMinimumSupportingHits'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/FatcatChainStatisticsOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sids/{sid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySid
      summary: Node by public SCOPe domain identifier
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sids/{sid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage for a SID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}

{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q024_fibronectin_fragment_selection","answer":"In the current SCOPe base release 2.08, d1uc6a1 (1uc6 A:6-109; ciliary neurotrophic factor receptor alpha) and d1o5dt2 (1o5d T:107-205; extracellular region of human tissue factor) are both assigned to Fibronectin type III family b.1.2.1. This family-level placement supports homology of the classified domains, but not identical function or whole-protein homology. Their shared superfamily b.1.2 also carries an evolutionary implication; the immunoglobulin-like beta-sandwich fold b.1 and all-beta class b describe progressively broader structural organization and alone would not establish homology.

SCOPe specifically flags d1o5dt2 as a fragment missing more than one-third of the common structure and/or sequence. Align it locally or structure-guidedly over the reliably observed common core, mask absent regions, report alignment coverage, and do not score unobserved residues as genuine deletions or use them to infer loss of strands. Global identities, RMSDs, and profile contributions should be interpreted only together with that restricted coverage.

Among these two, prefer the unflagged d1uc6a1 as a full-domain representative or full-length modeling template when other quality and target-similarity criteria are comparable. Do not use d1o5dt2 as the sole family representative, centroid, or template for regions it does not contain; retain it as a secondary, coverage-aware representative when its tissue-factor context, complexed state, or observed local region is specifically relevant. A model based on it can support only the covered core, not reconstruction of its missing portion without independent templates or evidence.

For family-diversity analyses, d1o5dt2's missing structure must not be counted as a novel shortened architecture or as extra sequence divergence. Estimate diversity on comparable observed positions and distinguish genuine variation between the CNTF-receptor and tissue-factor domains from truncation-induced gaps. Conversely, fragment status does not revoke its b.1.2.1 assignment or make it redundant: it can still document authentic variation in the region that is present. Neither family membership nor local similarity justifies transferring receptor, coagulation, ligand-binding, interface, or other specific functional annotations between d1uc6a1 and d1o5dt2; those require independent sequence, structural-context, biochemical, or literature evidence.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1uc6a1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1o5dt2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/107766","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/103884","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/110061","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49268","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/110060","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49267","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49266","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49265","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/48726","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/48724","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/48725","/api/v1/openapi.yaml","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/107766/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/107766/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/103884/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/103884/homology"]}]}
